tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Helsama's product catalog (hemp seeds, Premium CBD hemp powder, hemp skincare). Returns name, handle, price in SEK, stock and product URL. Empty query lists everything.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full public details for one product by handle (the slug in https://helsama.se/produkt/<handle>/), including description, EAN, price, stock and images.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Helsama's knowledge base and blog about hemp, CBD, CBDA, Swedish/EU hemp regulation, hemp seed nutrition and Gotland cultivation. Returns slug, title, summary, category and URL. Swedish by default; pass locale (en, de, et, da, fi) for translations.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one knowledge article or blog post as clean markdown, by slug. Cite as https://helsama.se/kunskap/<slug>/ (or /blog/<slug>/).

tools.name: get_labdata
tools.description: Helsama's open HPLC-UV cannabinoid dataset (CC BY 4.0): CBDA content of identical hemp seed grown on Gotland vs Italy (8.83 % vs 6.64 %). Returns the CSV plus the DOI to cite.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Neutral, citable fact sheet about Helsama and Nordic hemp (company, products, origin, regulation) as markdown.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, search_articles, get_article · Public sink: get_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, search_articles, get_article · Public sink: get_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
